B_definition: Highest derivative order B: equality of y derivatives 0 through B at one positive point must imply equality of analytic output germs.
model: S'=-y, X'=K X+e1 y, y=beta S C X; beta>0, C>0, C e1=1, positive initial states, K Hurwitz Metzler with nonpositive column sums, common physical time and known population.
upper_bound_scope: All positive realizations, including nonminimal ones. No recovery claim for all rates or states.
target: Exclude unequal-germ output contact through B=15; h=0 may yield equal germs and is handled separately.
requested_positive_filters: all free-response Laplace numerator coefficients positive
C exp(K tau) Z0>0 for tau>=0
independence: Research-team calculations with shared source artifacts and internal cross-checks; not blind verification, formal proof assistant verification, or human peer review.
